verdicts.title: Noncommutative reality-based algebras of rank 6
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We classify the RBA-bases of $6$-dimensional noncommutative semisimple algebras for which the algebra has a positive degree map. We show that these RBAs are parametrized by seven real numbers, the first four of which are positive and the remaining three arbitrary. Our classification gives formulas for their standard bases and structure constants. Using these we give a list of all noncommutative integral table algebras of rank 6 with order up to 150.
